subject.objective: Demonstrate that WB-007 provides a portable, fail-closed evaluation and observable trajectory assurance layer without expanding authority.

deterministic_checks.description: The complete Framework Contracts suite passes on the frozen PR revision.
deterministic_checks.command: bash scripts/test-sdd-contract.sh && python scripts/test-evaluation-contracts.py && python scripts/test-bootstrap-profiles.py && python scripts/test-profile-restore.py && python scripts/test-runtime-conformance.py && python scripts/test-integration-contracts.py && python scripts/test-integration-admission-evidence.py && python scripts/test-codex-adapter.py && python scripts/test-codex-hard-stops.py && bash scripts/validate-governance.sh && bash scripts/validate-publication.sh
deterministic_checks.evidence: GitHub Actions Framework Contracts run for the frozen revision

deterministic_checks.description: Disposable core and multi-runtime scaffolds contain the evaluation contract, templates, validator, and fail-closed default state.

output_criteria.description: Governance, lifecycle, artifacts, Work Block state, generated templates, validator, CI, navigation, and documentation form one consistent evaluation contract.
Evaluation cannot grant authority, waive deterministic failures, or require hidden reasoning/private chain-of-thought, and observable evidence excludes secrets/protected payloads.

trajectory_requirements.description: Observable delivery evidence shows Work Block binding, predeclared evaluation criteria, implementation, full CI, final review, evaluation, drift audit, and closeout without merge.
CI failures and review findings are recorded as observable failures followed by corrective changes and reruns rather than represented as passes.
